name: portage
description: Read-only access to your Canadian bank and credit card balances and transactions.
long_description: Portage lets Claude see balances and transactions from Canadian banks, through SimpleFIN Bridge or a direct Rogers Bank connection. Ask Claude to connect a bank and a sign-in page opens in your browser; passwords and codes are typed there, never in the chat. Logins are stored only on this computer, and nothing can move money.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List every connected bank and credit card account with its current balance.

tools.name: get_transactions
tools.description: Get transactions, newest first, filtered by account, dates, or text.

tools.name: connect_bank
tools.description: Open a sign-in page in your browser to connect Rogers Bank or SimpleFIN Bridge.
